authorization: Roger authorization (2026-09-22), the final worker publication: build one image from the exact frozen application SHA, capture its real immutable registry digest, record truthful evidence, then run the read-only image acceptance. readBackLimitation: The publication artifact's own bytes were read from the run's `cat` of the file it uploaded, not by downloading the artifact zip: this environment's egress proxy denies productionresultssa4.blob.core.windows.net, so the artifact download URL is unreachable from here. The upload step reported the uploaded zip's SHA-256 as 45263768ab551a38a770d33847760037eb67cec5055510ebc14fb4fff13b08f9, which equals the artifact metadata digest the Actions API returns, so the bytes read are the bytes stored. No value in this record was typed from memory or predicted.
